# Existing technology stack

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Fluent UI React Components, Manifest V3.
- Backend: Python 3.10+, FastAPI, Azure Functions ASGI adapter, structlog, limits with optional Redis storage.
- Testing: pytest, FastAPI TestClient, TypeScript/Vite production build.
- Existing integrations: OpenPhish feed and PhishTank API, both optional.
